_comment: The single source of truth for every Play asset window, byte cap, character limit and icon geometry value. Both languages read this file: scripts/core/*.mjs and scripts/store/*.py. No program restates a value from here - see .cursor/rules/verification-discipline.mdc and the factory-core spec requirement 'one check, one fact, one command'. Provenance for every value is requirements-preservation.md in openspec/changes/reduce-factory-to-core/.
_measuredFrom: Google Play Console, RU locale, app's Standartnaya stranitsa prilozheniya page, per-field inline strings - not the documentation

icon._rule: 512x512, 32-bit PNG with alpha, sRGB, at most 1024 KB; no drawn rounded mask or shadow

featureGraphic._rule: Exactly 1024x500, JPEG or 24-bit PNG without alpha, at most 15 MB

_aspectRule: The console states this sentence in EVERY screenshot field: 'Соотношение сторон изображения должно составлять 16:9 или 9:16'. Compared by integer cross-multiplication so an exactly-9:16 canvas is never a float near-miss.

phone._field: Скриншоты для смартфона: 2..8 files, each side 320..3840, <= 8 MB
phone._note: min is 4, not Play's absolute floor of 2: the large-screen section requires a minimum of 4.

tablet-7._field: Скриншоты для семидюймовых планшетов: <= 8 files, each side 320..3840, <= 8 MB
tablet-7._note: The laxer of the two tablet windows; the 1080px floor belongs to the 10-inch field.

tablet-10._field: Скриншоты для 10-дюймового планшета: <= 8 files, each side 1080..7680, <= 8 MB
tablet-10._note: Genuinely different from tablet-7. A single blanket predicate got one of them wrong and rejected a legal asset.

_maxRatio: Requirements 'no more than twice as long as the minimum dimension' cap. It is NOT the aspect rule, which applies to all three kinds separately.

releaseNote._note: Play truncates silently rather than refusing, and DOES show release notes on the store page. Every note in the paste block is measured, including one for a language the listing does not declare.

nonDegenerate._calibrated: 2026-09-25 against all 86 committed assets: least-structured real screenshot sd 45.15, fewest-coloured real screenshot 114 colours, flattest asset of any kind (a real icon) sd 52.00. A solid colour measures sd 0.00 and one colour.

_contactEmailNote: The developer account's monitored public support address. Not a secret; it does not belong in .env.

iconGeometry._strokeNote: 16px and 24px at 512. 16px is 3.375dp in the 108dp viewport and 1.5px at 48dp - the floor at which a launcher cell shows a line rather than a grey smear.
iconGeometry._fieldNote: Pillow measures clockwise from 0=right; Android measures counter-clockwise from 0=left-to-right. 45 and 315 are the same direction.
